## Two-Space Extension

The primary objective of this extension is to ensure Black's own safety rather than to attack White. If White is thick at the lower side, this extension also forestalls an attack while erasing that thickness.

This is undeniably a negative attitude. Still, it is part of the professional repertoire, and AI evaluates it similarly to the more common move <A:Q14>. This extension is submissive by comparison but has the added benefit of not being vulnerable to approach at <B:R12>.
